25. (Ka) kusalā dhammāti? Āmantā.

25. (a) Are wholesome states phenomena? Yes.

(Kha) dhammā kusalā dhammāti?

(b) Are phenomena wholesome phenomena?

Kusalā dhammā dhammā ceva kusalā dhammā ca. Avasesā dhammā na kusalā dhammā.

Wholesome phenomena are phenomena, and they are wholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.

(Ka) akusalā dhammāti? Āmantā.

(a) Are unwholesome states phenomena? Yes.

(Kha) dhammā akusalā dhammāti?

(b) Are phenomena unwholesome phenomena?

Akusalā dhammā dhammā ceva akusalā dhammā ca. Avasesā dhammā na akusalā dhammā.

Unwholesome phenomena are phenomena, and they are unwholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.

(Ka) abyākatā [M 3.0006] dhammāti? Āmantā.

(a) Are indeterminate states phenomena? Yes.

(Kha) dhammā abyākatā dhammāti?

(b) Are phenomena indeterminate phenomena?

Abyākatā dhammā dhammā ceva abyākatā dhammā ca. Avasesā dhammā na abyākatā dhammā.

Indeterminate phenomena are phenomena, and they are indeterminate phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

26. (Ka) na [V 3.0009] kusalā na dhammāti?

26. (a) Are states that are not wholesome not phenomena?

Kusalaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā dhammā na kusalā, dhammā. Kusalañca dhamme ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva kusalā na ca dhammā.

Excluding the wholesome, the remaining phenomena are not wholesome, but they are phenomena. Excluding the wholesome and phenomena, the remainder is neither wholesome nor a phenomenon.

(Kha) na dhammā na kusalā dhammāti? Āmantā.

(b) Are non-phenomena not wholesome-phenomena? Yes.

(Ka) na akusalā na dhammāti?

(a) Are states that are not unwholesome not phenomena?

Akusalaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā dhammā na akusalā, dhammā. Akusalañca dhamme ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva akusalā na ca dhammā.

Excluding the unwholesome, the remaining phenomena are not unwholesome, but they are phenomena. Excluding the unwholesome and phenomena, the remainder is neither unwholesome nor a phenomenon.

(Kha) na dhammā na akusalā dhammāti? Āmantā.

(b) Are non-phenomena not unwholesome-phenomena? Yes.

(Ka) na abyākatā na dhammāti?

(a) Are states that are not indeterminate not phenomena?

Abyākataṃ [T 2.0040] ṭhapetvā avasesā dhammā na abyākatā, dhammā. Abyākatañca dhamme ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva abyākatā na ca dhammā.

Excluding the indeterminate, the remaining phenomena are not indeterminate, but they are phenomena. Excluding the indeterminate and phenomena, the remainder is neither indeterminate nor a phenomenon.

(Kha) na dhammā na abyākatā dhammāti? Āmantā.

(b) Are non-phenomena not indeterminate-phenomena? Yes.

Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tassa cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjissanti.

At the dissolution-moment of every consciousness, at the arising-moment of a consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, for those in the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them wholesome states do not arise, but it is not that unwholesome states will not arise for them. At the dissolution-moment of the highest path, for arahants, and at the dissolution-moment of the consciousness immediately after which they will attain the highest path, for them both wholesome states do not arise and unwholesome states will not arise.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Chapter on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive Permutation: Person

99. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhantīti? No.

99. (a) For whom wholesome states cease, do unwholesome states cease for him? No.

(Kha) yassa [V 3.0043] vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā nirujjhantīti? No.

(b) Or, for whom unwholesome states cease, do wholesome states cease for him? No.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhantīti?

(a) For whom wholesome states cease, do indeterminate states cease for him?

Arūpe kusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ [M 3.0030] abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti. Pañcavokāre kusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of dissolution of wholesome states, for them wholesome states cease, but indeterminate states do not cease for them. In the five-constituent existence, at the moment of dissolution of wholesome states, for them both wholesome states cease and indeterminate states cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā nirujjhantīti?

(b) Or, for whom do indeterminate states cease, for him do wholesome states cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā [T 2.0074] nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti. Pañcavokāre kusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and in the course of existence at the moment of dissolution of a consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, for them indeterminate states cease, but for them wholesome states do not cease. In the five-constituent existence, at the moment of dissolution of wholesome states, for them both indeterminate states and wholesome states cease.

100. (Ka) yassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhantīti?

100. (a) For whom do unwholesome states cease, for him do indeterminate states cease?

Arūpe akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā dhammā nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti. Pañcavokāre akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of dissolution of unwholesome states, for them unwholesome states cease, but for them indeterminate states do not cease. In the five-constituent existence, at the moment of dissolution of unwholesome states, for them both unwholesome states and indeterminate states cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhantīti?

(b) Or, for whom do indeterminate states cease, for him do unwholesome states cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte akusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā nirujjhanti. Pañcavokāre akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhanti akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and in the course of existence at the moment of dissolution of a consciousness dissociated from the unwholesome, for them indeterminate states cease, but for them unwholesome states do not cease. In the five-constituent existence, at the moment of dissolution of unwholesome states, for them both indeterminate states and unwholesome states cease.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive Section: Location

101. (Ka) yattha [V 3.0044] kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhantīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or where unwholesome states cease, do wholesome states cease there? Yes.

Asaññasatte tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhanti, no ca tattha kusalā dhammā nirujjhanti. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre [T 2.0075] tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti.

In the non-percipient existence, indeterminate states cease there, but wholesome states do not cease there. In the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, both indeterminate states and wholesome states cease there.

105. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa akusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

105. (a) For one for whom wholesome states do not cease, do unwholesome states not cease for them?

Akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttaakusalavippayuttacittassa [V 3.0046][M 3.0032] bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

At the moment of dissolution of unwholesome states, for them wholesome states do not cease, but it is not the case that for them unwholesome states do not cease. For all at the moment of arising of consciousness, at the moment of dissolution of a consciousness dissociated from wholesome and unwholesome states, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both wholesome states and unwholesome states do not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

For whom do wholesome states not cease, for them do indeterminate states not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti. (Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

(Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti?

For one for whom, where wholesome phenomena do not cease, for that one, will indeterminate phenomena not cease there?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti.

At the arising-moment of all consciousness, at the dissolution-moment of consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, and for non-percipient beings, for them, wholesome phenomena do not cease there, but it is not the case that for them, indeterminate phenomena will not cease there. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them, both wholesome phenomena do not cease there and indeterminate phenomena will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or conversely, for one for whom, where indeterminate phenomena will not cease, for that one, do wholesome phenomena not cease there? Yes.

169. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa akusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

169. For a person for whom wholesome phenomena are not arising, are unwholesome phenomena not ceasing for that person?

Akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe akusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

At the dissolution-moment of unwholesome phenomena, for those persons wholesome phenomena are not arising, but unwholesome phenomena are ceasing for them. At the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the wholesome, at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both wholesome phenomena are not arising and unwholesome phenomena are not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or conversely, for a person for whom unwholesome phenomena are not ceasing, are wholesome phenomena not arising for that person?

Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Akusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

At the arising-moment of wholesome phenomena, for those persons unwholesome phenomena are not ceasing, but wholesome phenomena are arising for them. At the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome, at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the wholesome, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both unwholesome phenomena are not ceasing and wholesome phenomena are not arising.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

For a person for whom wholesome phenomena are not arising, are indeterminate phenomena not ceasing for that person?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ [V 3.0075] bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā [T 2.0106] ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind in the course of existence, for them wholesome phenomena are not arising, but indeterminate phenomena are ceasing for them. For all who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the wholesome in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, for them both wholesome phenomena are not arising and indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or conversely, for a person for whom indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing, are wholesome phenomena not arising for that person?

Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā [M 3.0053] dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

At the arising-moment of wholesome phenomena, for those persons indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing, but wholesome phenomena are arising for them. For all who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the wholesome in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, for them both indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing and wholesome phenomena are not arising.

170. (Ka) yassa akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

170. For a person for whom unwholesome phenomena are not arising, are indeterminate phenomena not ceasing for that person?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte akusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and for those at the dissolution-moment of a mind in the course of existence, for them unwholesome phenomena are not arising, but indeterminate phenomena are ceasing for them. For all who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, for them both unwholesome phenomena are not arising and indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa akusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or conversely, for a person for whom indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing, are unwholesome phenomena not arising for that person?

Akusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte akusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

At the arising-moment of unwholesome phenomena, for them indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing, but unwholesome phenomena are arising for them. For all who are being reborn; for those at the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome in the course of existence; and for those in the formless realm at the dissolution-moment of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena, for them both indeterminate phenomena are not ceasing and unwholesome phenomena are not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) Contrary (Sphere)

171. (Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tattha akusalā dhammā na [T 2.0107] nirujjhantīti? Āmantā.

171. Where wholesome phenomena do not arise, there do unwholesome phenomena not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yattha [V 3.0076] vā pana akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti? Āmantā.

Or conversely, where unwholesome phenomena do not cease, there do wholesome phenomena not arise? Yes.

(Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti? Nirujjhanti.

Where wholesome phenomena do not arise, there do indeterminate phenomena not cease? They cease.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti? Natthi.

Or conversely, where indeterminate phenomena do not cease, there do wholesome phenomena not arise? There is not.

172. (Ka) yattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti? Nirujjhanti.

172. Where unwholesome phenomena do not arise, there do indeterminate phenomena not cease? They cease.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti? Natthi.

Or conversely, where indeterminate phenomena do not cease, there do unwholesome phenomena not arise? There is not.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) Contrary (Person and Sphere)

173. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

173. For a person for whom wholesome phenomena are not arising in a certain realm, are unwholesome phenomena not ceasing for that person in that realm?

Akusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti[M 3.0054], no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe akusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

At the dissolution-moment of unwholesome phenomena, for them there wholesome phenomena do not arise, but unwholesome phenomena are ceasing for them there. At the arising-moment of a mind dissociated from the wholesome, at the dissolution-moment of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome, and for non-percipient beings—for them there both wholesome phenomena do not arise and unwholesome phenomena do not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or conversely, for a person for whom unwholesome phenomena are not ceasing in a certain realm, are wholesome phenomena not arising for that person in that realm?

Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Akusalavippayuttacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

For those at the moment of arising of wholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, unwholesome states are not ceasing; but it is not that for them in that plane of existence, wholesome states are not arising. For those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane of existence, unwholesome states are not ceasing and wholesome states are not arising.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0108] yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

For the person for whom, in the plane of existence where, wholesome states are not arising, for that person, in that plane of existence, are indeterminate states not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ [V 3.0077] cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and for those at the moment of dissolution of a mind in the course of existence, for them in that plane of existence, wholesome states are not arising; but it is not that for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing. For all who are being reborn, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the wholesome in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of wholesome and unwholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, wholesome states are not arising and indeterminate states are not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or again, for the person for whom, in the plane of existence where, indeterminate states are not ceasing, for that person, in that plane of existence, are wholesome states not arising?

Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

For those at the moment of arising of wholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing; but it is not that for them in that plane of existence, wholesome states are not arising. For all who are being reborn, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the wholesome in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of wholesome and unwholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing and wholesome states are not arising.

174. (Ka) yassa yattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhantīti?

174. For the person for whom, in the plane of existence where, unwholesome states are not arising, for that person, in that plane of existence, are indeterminate states not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte akusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti.

For all who are passing away, and for those at the moment of dissolution of a mind in the course of existence, for them in that plane of existence, unwholesome states are not arising; but it is not that for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing. For all who are being reborn, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of wholesome and unwholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, unwholesome states are not arising and indeterminate states are not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [T 2.0109] abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti?

Or again, for the person for whom, in the plane of existence where, indeterminate states are not ceasing, for that person, in that plane of existence, are unwholesome states not arising?

Akusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjanti. Sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte akusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe arūpe kusalākusalānaṃ [M 3.0055] bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhanti akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti.

For those at the moment of arising of unwholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing; but it is not that for them in that plane of existence, unwholesome states are not arising. For all who are being reborn, for those at the moment of arising of a mind dissociated from the unwholesome in the course of existence, and for those in the formless plane at the moment of dissolution of wholesome and unwholesome states, for them in that plane of existence, indeterminate states are not ceasing and unwholesome states are not arising.

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Past Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: Individual

175. (Ka) yassa [V 3.0078] kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom wholesome states arose, for that person did unwholesome states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, for whom unwholesome states ceased, for that one did wholesome states arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whom wholesome states arose, for that one did indeterminate states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, for whom indeterminate states ceased, for that one did wholesome states arise? Yes.

176. (Ka) yassa akusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom unwholesome states arose, for that person did indeterminate states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa akusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

175. Or again, for a person for whom indeterminate states ceased, for that person did unwholesome states arise? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: Plane

177. (Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

Where wholesome states arose, there did unwholesome states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

Or again, where unwholesome states ceased, there did wholesome states arise? Yes.

(Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tattha abyākatā dhammā [T 2.0110] nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

Where wholesome states arose, did indeterminate states cease there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

176. Or again, where indeterminate states ceased, did wholesome states arise there?

Asaññasatte tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

In the non-percipient existence, indeterminate states ceased there, but wholesome states did not arise there. In the four-constituent existence and the five-constituent existence, both indeterminate states ceased there and wholesome states arose there.

178. (Ka) yattha [V 3.0079] akusalā dhammā uppajjittha tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

Where unwholesome states arose, did indeterminate states cease there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

177. Or again, where indeterminate states ceased, did unwholesome states arise there?

Asaññasatte tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre [M 3.0056] tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha akusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

In the non-percipient existence, indeterminate states ceased there, but unwholesome states did not arise there. In the four-constituent existence and the five-constituent existence, both indeterminate states ceased there and unwholesome states arose there.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: Individual and Plane

179. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom wholesome states arose in a certain plane, did unwholesome states cease for that person in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for a person for whom unwholesome states ceased in a certain plane, did wholesome states arise for that person in that plane?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye akusale citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For the beings in the Pure Abodes, when the second unwholesome mind is occurring, for them unwholesome states ceased there, but wholesome states did not arise for them there. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both unwholesome states ceased there and wholesome states arose there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whom wholesome states arose where, for that one did indeterminate states cease there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā [T 2.0111] dhammā nirujjhittha tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane, indeterminate states had ceased, for that person, in that plane, had wholesome states arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states had ceased there, but wholesome states had not arisen for them there. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both indeterminate states had ceased there and wholesome states had arisen there.

180. (Ka) yassa [V 3.0080] yattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

180. (a) For whichever person, in whichever plane, unwholesome states had arisen, for that person, in that plane, had indeterminate states ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane, indeterminate states had ceased, for that person, in that plane, had unwholesome states arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha akusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states had ceased there, but unwholesome states had not arisen for them there. For the other beings of the four-constituent and five-constituent existences, for them both indeterminate states had ceased there and unwholesome states had arisen there.

186. (Ka) yassa yattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhitthāti?

186. (a) For whichever person, in whichever plane, unwholesome states had not arisen, for that person, in that plane, had indeterminate states not ceased?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā na uppajjittha abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhittha.

For beings in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them there unwholesome states had not arisen, but indeterminate states had ceased. For those being reborn into the Pure Abodes, for them there both unwholesome states had not arisen and indeterminate states had not ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhittha tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, for whichever person, in whichever plane, indeterminate states had not ceased, for that person, in that plane, had unwholesome states not arisen? Yes.

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: Person

187. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

187. (a) For whomever wholesome states will arise, for them will unwholesome states cease?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those immediately after whose consciousness they will attain the supreme path, for them wholesome states will arise, but for them unwholesome states will not cease. For the other beings, for them both wholesome states will arise and unwholesome states will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, for whomever unwholesome states will cease, for them will wholesome states arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever wholesome states will arise, for them will indeterminate states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā [T 2.0114] nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti?

(b) Or again, for whomever indeterminate states will cease, for them will wholesome states arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti.

For those endowed with the supreme path and for arahants, for them indeterminate states will cease, but for them wholesome states will not arise. For the others, for them both indeterminate states will cease and wholesome states will arise.

188. (Ka) yassa [V 3.0083] akusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

188. For whomever unwholesome states will arise, for that person will indeterminate states cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa akusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti?

Or again, for whomever indeterminate states will cease, for that person will unwholesome states arise?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti[M 3.0059], no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā uppajjissanti. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti akusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for arahants, and for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them indeterminate states will cease, but for them unwholesome states will not arise. For the others, for them both indeterminate states will cease and unwholesome states will arise.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) Occasion of Conformity

189. (Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

189. (A) Where wholesome states will arise, will unwholesome states cease there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or again, where unwholesome states will cease, will wholesome states arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

(A) Where wholesome states will arise, will indeterminate states cease there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti?

(B) Or again, where indeterminate states will cease, will wholesome states arise there?

Asaññasatte tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti.

In the plane of non-percipient beings, indeterminate states will cease there, but wholesome states will not arise there. In the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, both indeterminate states will cease there and wholesome states will arise there.

190. (Ka) yattha [T 2.0115] akusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

190. (A) Where unwholesome states will arise, will indeterminate states cease there? Yes.

Asaññasatte tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tattha akusalā [V 3.0084] dhammā uppajjissanti. Catuvokāre pañcavokāre tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti akusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti.

In the plane of non-percipient beings, indeterminate states will cease there, but unwholesome states will not arise there. In the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, both indeterminate states will cease there and unwholesome states will arise there.

(C) Conformity: Person and Occasion

191. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

191. For a person for whom, in a plane where, wholesome states will arise, will unwholesome states cease for that person there?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them wholesome states will arise there, but for them unwholesome states will not cease there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both wholesome states will arise there and unwholesome states will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for a person for whom, in a plane where, unwholesome states will cease, will wholesome states arise for that person there? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjissanti. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā uppajjissanti.

For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both indeterminate states will cease there and wholesome states will arise there.

192. (Ka) yassa [T 2.0116] yattha akusalā dhammā uppajjissanti tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

192. For a person for whom, in a plane where, unwholesome states will arise, will indeterminate states cease for that person there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjissantīti?

Or again, for a person for whom, in a plane where, indeterminate states will cease, will unwholesome states arise for that person there?

For those endowed with the supreme path, for arahants, for those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states will cease there, but for them unwholesome states will not arise there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both indeterminate states will cease there and unwholesome states will arise there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(D) The Negative: Person

193. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti tassa akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti? Āmantā.

193. For whomever wholesome states will not arise, for that person will unwholesome states not cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjissantīti?

Or again, for whomever unwholesome states will not cease, for that person will wholesome states not arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti. Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ tesaṃ akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjissanti.

For those who will attain the supreme path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them unwholesome states will not cease, but it is not that for them wholesome states will not arise. For those endowed with the supreme path and for arahants, for them both unwholesome states will not cease and wholesome states will not arise.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti tassa abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti?

For whomever wholesome states will not arise, for that person will indeterminate states not cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ tesaṃ kusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjissanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti.

For those endowed with the supreme path and for arahants, for them wholesome states will not arise, but it is not that for them indeterminate states will not cease. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them both wholesome states will not arise and indeterminate states will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā [T 2.0117] pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā na uppajjissantīti? Āmantā.

194. (Ka) yassa akusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti tassa abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti?

194. For whomever unwholesome states will not arise, for that person will indeterminate states not cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ akusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti, no ca tesaṃ [M 3.0061] abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā [V 3.0086] ca dhammā na uppajjissanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti.

For those endowed with the supreme path, for arahants, and for those who, immediately after a certain consciousness, will attain the supreme path, for them unwholesome states will not arise, but for them indeterminate states will cease. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them both unwholesome states will not arise and indeterminate states will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa akusalā dhammā na uppajjissantīti? Āmantā.

Or for any person for whom indeterminate states will not cease, for that person, will unwholesome states not arise? Yes, they will not arise.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(E) Negative: Plane of Existence

(A) Where wholesome states will not arise, there will indeterminate states not cease? They will cease.

(Kha) yattha vā pana abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjissantīti? Natthi.

(B) Or where indeterminate states will not cease, there will wholesome states not arise? There is no such plane.

196. (Ka) yattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjissanti tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti? Nirujjhissanti.

196. (A) Where unwholesome states will not arise, there will indeterminate states not cease? They will cease.

(B) Or where indeterminate states will not cease, there will unwholesome states not arise? There is no such plane.

198. (A) For whomever, wherever unwholesome states will not arise, for them there will indeterminate states not cease?

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Positive: Person

199. (Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjanti tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

199. (A) For whomever wholesome states are arising, for that person have unwholesome states ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjantīti?

(B) Or for whomever unwholesome states have ceased, for that person are wholesome states arising?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ [V 3.0088] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjanti. Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjanti.

For all at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them unwholesome states have ceased, but for them wholesome states are not arising. At the arising-moment of wholesome states, for them both unwholesome states have ceased and wholesome states are arising.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(A) For whomever wholesome states are arising, for that person have indeterminate states ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjantīti?

(B) Or for whomever indeterminate states have ceased, for that person are wholesome states arising?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjanti. Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjanti.

For all at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states have ceased, but for them wholesome states are not arising. At the arising-moment of wholesome states, for them both indeterminate states have ceased and wholesome states are arising.

200. (Ka) yassa [T 2.0120] akusalā dhammā uppajjanti tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

200. (A) For whomever unwholesome states are arising, for that person have indeterminate states ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa akusalā dhammā uppajjantīti?

(B) Or for whomever indeterminate states have ceased, for that person are unwholesome states arising?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe akusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā uppajjanti. Akusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhittha akusalā ca dhammā uppajjanti.

For all at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from the unwholesome, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states have ceased, but for them unwholesome states are not arising. At the arising-moment of unwholesome states, for them both indeterminate states have ceased and unwholesome states are arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) Positive: Plane of Existence

201. Yattha [M 3.0063] kusalā dhammā uppajjanti tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti?…Pe….

201. Where wholesome states arise, have unwholesome states ceased there? …and so on….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(C) Positive: Person and Plane of Existence

202. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

202. (a) For any person for whom wholesome states arise in any place, have unwholesome states ceased for that person there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 3.0089] vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjantīti?

(b) Or again, for any person for whom unwholesome states have ceased in any place, are wholesome states arising for that person there?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe kusalavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjanti. Kusalānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhittha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjanti.

For all persons at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and at the moment of arising of consciousness dissociated from the wholesome, for them unwholesome states have ceased there, but wholesome states are not arising for them there. At the moment of arising of wholesome states, for them both unwholesome states have ceased there and wholesome states are arising there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhittha tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjantīti?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā [T 2.0129] ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti.

For all at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, at the moment of arising of a consciousness dissociated from the unwholesome, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, unwholesome states do not arise, but it is not that for them, there, indeterminate states will not cease. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for them, there, both unwholesome states do not arise and indeterminate states will not cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 3.0097] vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjantīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom, in a certain plane, indeterminate states will not cease, for that person, in that plane, are unwholesome states not arising? Yes.

219. (Ka) yassa [M 3.0069] kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa akusalā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

(Ka) For a person for whom wholesome states have arisen, for that person will unwholesome states cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

218. For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness—for them wholesome states have arisen, but for them unwholesome states will not cease. For the other persons, for them both wholesome states have arisen and unwholesome states will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom unwholesome states will cease, for that person have wholesome states arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

(Ka) For a person for whom wholesome states have arisen, for that person will indeterminate states cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalā dhammā uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those at the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for them wholesome states have arisen, but for them indeterminate states will not cease. For the other persons, for them both wholesome states have arisen and indeterminate states will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for a person for whom indeterminate states will cease, for that person have wholesome states arisen? Yes.

220. (Ka) yassa akusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

219. (Ka) For a person for whom unwholesome states have arisen, for that person will indeterminate states cease?

222. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

222. For whom, where wholesome states have arisen, for that one, there will unwholesome states cease?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them wholesome states have arisen there, but for them unwholesome states will not cease there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, for them both wholesome states have arisen there and unwholesome states will cease there.

(Kha) yassa [M 3.0070] vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whom, where unwholesome states will cease, for that one, there have wholesome states arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For the beings in the Pure Abodes, while the second consciousness is occurring, for them unwholesome states will cease there, but for them wholesome states have not arisen there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, for them both unwholesome states will cease there and wholesome states have arisen there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

For whom, where wholesome states have arisen, for that one, there will indeterminate states cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ [V 3.0099] tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them wholesome states have arisen there, but for them indeterminate states will not cease there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, for them both wholesome states have arisen there and indeterminate states will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa [T 2.0131] tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whom, where indeterminate states will cease, for that one, there have wholesome states arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For the beings in the Pure Abodes while the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states will cease there, but for them wholesome states have not arisen there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes of existence, for them both indeterminate states will cease there and wholesome states have arisen there.

223. (Ka) yassa yattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissantīti?

223. For whom, where unwholesome states have arisen, for that one, there will indeterminate states cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, for them unwholesome states have arisen there, but for them indeterminate states will not cease there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both unwholesome states have arisen there and indeterminate states will cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whom, where indeterminate states will cease, for that one, there have unwholesome states arisen?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā dhammā nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā uppajjittha. Itaresaṃ catuvokārānaṃ pañcavokārānaṃ tesaṃ tattha abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhissanti akusalā ca dhammā uppajjittha.

For the beings in the Pure Abodes while the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings, for them indeterminate states will cease there, but for them unwholesome states have not arisen there. For the others in the four-constituent and five-constituent planes, for them both indeterminate states will cease there and unwholesome states have arisen there.

227. (Ka) yassa yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjittha tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti?

227. For whom, where wholesome states have not arisen, for that one, there will unwholesome states not cease?

Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissanti. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjittha akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti.

For those in the Pure Abodes, when the second consciousness is occurring, for them there wholesome states have not arisen, but it is not that for them there unwholesome states will not cease. For non-percipient beings, for them there both wholesome states have not arisen and unwholesome states will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjitthāti?

Or again, for whom, where unwholesome states will not cease, for that one, there have wholesome states not arisen?

Aggamaggasamaṅgīnaṃ arahantānaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti tesaṃ tattha akusalā dhammā na nirujjhissanti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjittha. Asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha akusalā ca dhammā na nirujjhissanti kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjittha.

For those endowed with the highest path, for Arahants, and for those who will attain the highest path immediately after a certain consciousness, for them there unwholesome states will not cease, but it is not that for them there wholesome states have not arisen. For non-percipient beings, for them there both unwholesome states will not cease and wholesome states have not arisen.

(Ka) yassa [V 3.0101] yattha kusalā dhammā na uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti? Nirujjhissanti.

For whom, where wholesome states did not arise, for him there will indeterminate states not cease? They will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa tattha kusalā dhammā na [T 2.0133] uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

Or for whom, on the other hand, where indeterminate states will not cease, for him there did wholesome states not arise? They arose.

228. (Ka) yassa yattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjittha tassa tattha abyākatā dhammā na nirujjhissantīti? Nirujjhissanti.

228. For whom, where unwholesome states did not arise, for him there will indeterminate states not cease? They will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha abyākatā [M 3.0072] dhammā na nirujjhissanti tassa tattha akusalā dhammā na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

Or for whom, on the other hand, where indeterminate states will not cease, for him there did unwholesome states not arise? They arose.

229. (Ka) yo kusalaṃ dhammaṃ bhāveti so akusalaṃ dhammaṃ pajahatīti? Āmantā.

229. Does one who develops a wholesome state abandon an unwholesome state? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana akusalaṃ dhammaṃ pajahati so kusalaṃ dhammaṃ bhāvetīti? Āmantā.

Or does one who abandons an unwholesome state develop a wholesome state? Yes.

(Ka) yo kusalaṃ dhammaṃ na bhāveti so akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nappajahatīti? Āmantā.

Does one who does not develop a wholesome state not abandon an unwholesome state? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nappajahati so kusalaṃ dhammaṃ na bhāvetīti? Āmantā…pe….

Or does one who does not abandon an unwholesome state not develop a wholesome state? Yes. …pe…

Bhāvanāvāro.

The Section on Development.

Dhammayamakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Yamaka on Phenomena is concluded.

There are twenty-two faculties: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the mind faculty, the female faculty, the male faculty, the life faculty, the pleasure faculty, the pain faculty, the joy faculty, the displeasure faculty, the equanimity faculty, the faith faculty, the energy faculty, the mindfulness faculty, the concentration faculty, the wisdom faculty, the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown,' the faculty of final knowledge, and the faculty of one who has final knowledge.

(a) Positive

94. (Ka) cakkhu [V 3.0127][M 3.0086] cakkhundriyanti?

94. (a) Is the eye the eye-faculty?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu cakkhu, na cakkhundriyaṃ. Cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhu ceva cakkhundriyañca.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are the eye, but not the eye-faculty. The eye-faculty is both the eye and the eye-faculty.

(Kha) cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhūti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the eye-faculty the eye? Yes.

(Ka) sotaṃ sotindriyanti?

(a) Is the ear the ear-faculty?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ [T 2.0147] sotaṃ, na sotindriyaṃ. Sotindriyaṃ sotañceva sotindriyañca.

The divine ear and the stream of craving are the ear, but not the ear-faculty. The ear-faculty is both the ear and the ear-faculty.

(Kha) sotindriyaṃ sotanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the ear-faculty the ear? Yes.

(Ka) ghānaṃ ghānindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the nose the nose-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) ghānindriyaṃ ghānanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the nose-faculty the nose? Yes.

(Ka) jivhā jivhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the tongue the tongue-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) jivhindriyaṃ jivhāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the tongue-faculty the tongue? Yes.

(Ka) kāyo kāyindriyanti?

(a) Is the body the body-faculty?

Kāyindriyaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso kāyo avasesā kāyo (sī. syā. ka.), na kāyindriyaṃ. Kāyindriyaṃ kāyo ceva kāyindriyañca.

Setting aside the body-faculty, the remaining body is the body, but not the body-faculty. The body-faculty is both the body and the body-faculty.

(Kha) kāyindriyaṃ kāyoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the body-faculty the body? Yes.

(Ka) mano manindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the mind the mind-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) manindriyaṃ manoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the mind-faculty the mind? Yes.

(Ka) itthī [V 3.0128] itthindriyanti? No.

(a) Is the female the female-faculty? No.

(Kha) itthindriyaṃ itthīti? No.

(b) Is the female-faculty the female? No.

(Ka) puriso purisindriyanti? No.

(a) Is the male the male-faculty? No.

(Kha) purisindriyaṃ purisoti? No.

(b) Is the male-faculty the male? No.

(Ka) jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is life the life-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) jīvitindriyaṃ jīvitanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the life-faculty life? Yes.

(Ka) sukhaṃ sukhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is pleasure the pleasure-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) sukhindriyaṃ sukhanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the pleasure-faculty pleasure? Yes.

(Ka) dukkhaṃ dukkhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is pain the pain-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) dukkhindriyaṃ dukkhanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the pain-faculty pain? Yes.

(Ka) somanassaṃ somanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is joy the joy-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) somanassindriyaṃ somanassanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the joy-faculty joy? Yes.

(Ka) domanassaṃ domanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is sorrow the sorrow-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) domanassindriyaṃ domanassanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the sorrow-faculty sorrow? Yes.

(Ka) upekkhā [M 3.0087] upekkhindriyanti?

(a) Is equanimity the equanimity-faculty?

Upekkhindriyaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā upekkhā, na upekkhindriyaṃ. Upekkhindriyaṃ upekkhā ceva upekkhindriyañca.

Setting aside the equanimity-faculty, the remaining equanimity is not the equanimity-faculty. The equanimity-faculty is both equanimity and the equanimity-faculty.

(Kha) upekkhindriyaṃ upekkhāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the equanimity-faculty equanimity? Yes.

(Ka) saddhā saddhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is faith the faith-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) saddhindriyaṃ saddhāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the faith-faculty faith? Yes.

(Ka) vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is energy the energy-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyanti? Āmantā[T 2.0148].

(b) Is the energy-faculty energy? Yes.

(Ka) sati satindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is mindfulness the mindfulness-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) satindriyaṃ satīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the mindfulness-faculty mindfulness? Yes.

(Ka) samādhi [V 3.0129] samādhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is concentration the concentration-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) samādhindriyaṃ samādhīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the concentration-faculty concentration? Yes.

(Ka) paññā paññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is wisdom the wisdom-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) paññindriyaṃ paññāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the wisdom-faculty wisdom? Yes.

(Ka) anaññātaññassāmīti anaññātaññassāmītindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is 'I shall come to know the unknown' the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown'? Yes.

(Kha) anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ anaññātaññassāmīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown' 'I shall come to know the unknown'? Yes.

(Ka) aññaṃ aññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is final knowledge the faculty of final knowledge? Yes.

(Kha) aññindriyaṃ aññanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the faculty of final knowledge final knowledge? Yes.

(Ka) aññātāvī aññātāvindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is one who has final knowledge the faculty of one who has final knowledge? Yes.

(Kha) aññātāvindriyaṃ aññātāvīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is the faculty of one who has final knowledge one who has final knowledge? Yes.

Negative

95. (Ka) na cakkhu na cakkhundriyanti? Āmantā.

95. (a) Is that which is not the eye not the eye-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na cakkhundriyaṃ na cakkhūti?

(b) Is that which is not the eye-faculty not the eye?

Dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu na cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhu. Cakkhuñca cakkhundriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca cakkhundriyaṃ.

The divine eye and the wisdom eye are not the eye-faculty, but are the eye. Excluding the eye and the eye-faculty, the remaining are neither the eye nor the eye-faculty.

(Ka) na sotaṃ na sotindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the ear not the ear-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na sotindriyaṃ na sotanti?

(b) Is that which is not the ear-faculty not the ear?

Dibbasotaṃ taṇhāsotaṃ na sotindriyaṃ, sotaṃ. Sotañca sotindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva sotaṃ na ca sotindriyaṃ.

The divine ear and the stream of craving are not the ear-faculty, but are the ear. Excluding the ear and the ear-faculty, the remaining are neither the ear nor the ear-faculty.

(Ka) na ghānaṃ na ghānindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the nose not the nose-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na ghānindriyaṃ na ghānanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the nose-faculty not the nose? Yes.

(Ka) na jivhā na jivhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the tongue not the tongue-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na jivhindriyaṃ na jivhāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the tongue-faculty not the tongue? Yes.

(Ka) na kāyo na kāyindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the body not the body-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na kāyindriyaṃ na kāyoti?

(b) Is that which is not the body-faculty not the body?

Kāyindriyaṃ ṭhapetvā avaseso na kāyindriyaṃ, kāyo. Kāyañca kāyindriyañca ṭhapetvā avaseso na ceva kāyo na [T 2.0149] ca kāyindriyaṃ.

Excluding the body-faculty, the remaining are not the body-faculty, but are the body. Excluding the body and the body-faculty, the remaining are neither the body nor the body-faculty.

(Ka) na [V 3.0130] mano na manindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the mind not the mind-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na manindriyaṃ na manoti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the mind-faculty not the mind? Yes.

(Ka) na [M 3.0088] itthī na itthindriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not a woman not the female faculty?

Itthindriyaṃ na itthī, itthindriyaṃ. Itthiñca itthindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva itthī na ca itthindriyaṃ.

The female faculty is not a woman, but it is the female faculty. Excluding a woman and the female faculty, the remaining are neither a woman nor the female faculty.

(Kha) na itthindriyaṃ na itthīti?

(b) Is that which is not the female faculty not a woman?

Itthī na itthindriyaṃ, itthī. Itthiñca itthindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva itthī na ca itthindriyaṃ.

A woman is not the female faculty, but she is a woman. Excluding a woman and the female faculty, the remaining are neither a woman nor the female faculty.

(Ka) na puriso na purisindriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not a man not the male faculty?

Purisindriyaṃ na puriso, purisindriyaṃ. Purisañca purisindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva puriso na ca purisindriyaṃ.

The male faculty is not a man, but it is the male faculty. Excluding a man and the male faculty, the remaining are neither a man nor the male faculty.

(Kha) na purisindriyaṃ na purisoti?

(b) Is that which is not the male faculty not a man?

Puriso na purisindriyaṃ, puriso. Purisañca purisindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva puriso na ca purisindriyaṃ.

A man is not the male faculty; he is a man. Excluding a man and the male faculty, the remainder is neither a man nor the male faculty.

(Ka) na jīvitaṃ na jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not life not the life-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na jīvitindriyaṃ na jīvitanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the life-faculty not life? Yes.

(Ka) na sukhaṃ na sukhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not pleasure not the pleasure-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na sukhindriyaṃ na sukhanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the pleasure-faculty not pleasure? Yes.

(Ka) na dukkhaṃ na dukkhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not pain not the pain-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na dukkhindriyaṃ na dukkhanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the pain-faculty not pain? Yes.

(Ka) na somanassaṃ na somanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not joy not the joy-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na somanassindriyaṃ na somanassanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the joy-faculty not joy? Yes.

(Ka) na domanassaṃ na domanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not displeasure not the displeasure-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na domanassindriyaṃ na domanassanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the displeasure-faculty not displeasure? Yes.

(Ka) na upekkhā na upekkhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not equanimity not the equanimity-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na upekkhindriyaṃ na upekkhāti?

(b) Is that which is not the equanimity-faculty not equanimity?

Upekkhindriyaṃ [V 3.0131] ṭhapetvā avasesā na upekkhindriyaṃ, upekkhā. Upekkhañca upekkhindriyañca ṭhapetvā avasesā [T 2.0150] na ceva upekkhā na ca upekkhindriyaṃ.

Excluding the equanimity-faculty, the remainder is not the equanimity-faculty; it is equanimity. Excluding equanimity and the equanimity-faculty, the remainder is neither equanimity nor the equanimity-faculty.

(Ka) na saddhā na saddhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not faith not the faith-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na saddhindriyaṃ na saddhāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the faith-faculty not faith? Yes.

(Ka) na vīriyaṃ na vīriyindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not energy not the energy-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na vīriyindriyaṃ na vīriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the energy-faculty not energy? Yes.

(Ka) na sati na satindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not mindfulness not the mindfulness-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na satindriyaṃ na satīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the mindfulness-faculty not mindfulness? Yes.

(Ka) na samādhi na samādhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not concentration not the concentration-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na samādhindriyaṃ na samādhīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the concentration-faculty not concentration? Yes.

(Ka) na paññā na paññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not wisdom not the wisdom-faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na paññindriyaṃ na paññāti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the wisdom-faculty not wisdom? Yes.

(Ka) na anaññātaññassāmīti na anaññātaññassāmītindriyanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) na anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na anaññātaññassāmīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the faculty of 'I will know the unknown' not 'I will know the unknown'? Yes.

(Ka) na aññaṃ na aññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not final knowledge not the faculty of final knowledge? Yes.

(Kha) na aññindriyaṃ na aññanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the faculty of final knowledge not final knowledge? Yes.

(Ka) na [M 3.0089] aññātāvī na aññātāvindriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not one who has final knowledge not the faculty of one who has final knowledge? Yes.

(Kha) na aññātāvindriyaṃ na aññātāvīti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not the faculty of one who has final knowledge not one who has final knowledge? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā [V 3.0140] aññātāvindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the faculty of one who has final knowledge?

Aññātāvindriyaṃ indriyañceva aññātāvindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na aññātāvindriyaṃ.

The faculty of one who has final knowledge is both a faculty and the faculty of one who has final knowledge. The remaining faculties are not the faculty of one who has final knowledge.
