3. Suddhindriyavāro

3. Section on Simple Faculties

(Ka) anulomaṃ

(a) Positive Order

140. (Ka) cakkhu [M 3.0099] indriyanti? Āmantā.

140. (a) Is the eye a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā cakkhundriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the eye-faculty?

Cakkhundriyaṃ indriyañceva cakkhundriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na cakkhundriyaṃ.

The eye-faculty is both a faculty and the eye-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the eye-faculty.

(Ka) sotaṃ indriyanti?

(a) Is the ear a faculty?

Yaṃ sotaṃ indriyaṃ taṃ sotañceva indriyañca. Avasesaṃ sotaṃ na indriyaṃ.

That ear which is a faculty is both the ear and a faculty. The remaining ear is not a faculty.

(Kha) indriyā sotindriyanti? Sotindriyaṃ indriyañceva sotindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na sotindriyaṃ.

(b) Are faculties the ear-faculty? The ear-faculty is both a faculty and the ear-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the ear-faculty.

(Ka) ghānaṃ indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the nose a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā ghānindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the nose-faculty?

Ghānindriyaṃ indriyañceva ghānindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na ghānindriyaṃ.

The nose-faculty is both a faculty and the nose-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the nose-faculty.

(Ka) jivhā [V 3.0148] indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the tongue a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā jivhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the tongue-faculty?

Jivhindriyaṃ indriyañceva jivhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na jivhindriyaṃ.

The tongue-faculty is both a faculty and the tongue-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the tongue-faculty.

(Ka) kāyo indriyanti?

(a) Is the body a faculty?

Yo kāyo indriyaṃ so kāyo ceva indriyañca. Avaseso kāyo na indriyā.

That body which is a faculty is both the body and a faculty. The remaining body is not a faculty.

(Kha) indriyā kāyindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the body-faculty?

Kāyindriyaṃ indriyañceva [T 2.0164] kāyindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na kāyindriyaṃ.

The body-faculty is both a faculty and the body-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the body-faculty.

(Ka) mano indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the mind a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā manindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the mind-faculty?

Manindriyaṃ indriyañceva manindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na manindriyaṃ.

The mind-faculty is both a faculty and the mind-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the mind-faculty.

(Ka) itthī indriyanti? No.

(a) Is femininity a faculty? No.

(Kha) indriyā itthindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the femininity-faculty?

Itthindriyaṃ indriyañceva itthindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na itthindriyaṃ.

The femininity-faculty is both a faculty and the femininity-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the femininity-faculty.

(Ka) puriso indriyanti? No.

(a) Is masculinity a faculty? No.

(Kha) indriyā purisindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the masculinity-faculty?

Purisindriyaṃ indriyañceva purisindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na purisindriyaṃ.

The masculinity-faculty is both a faculty and the masculinity-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the masculinity-faculty.

(Ka) jīvitaṃ indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is life a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā jīvitindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the life-faculty?

Jīvitindriyaṃ indriyañceva jīvitindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na jīvitindriyaṃ.

The life-faculty is both a faculty and the life-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the life-faculty.

(Ka) sukhaṃ indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is pleasure a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā sukhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the pleasure-faculty?

Sukhindriyaṃ indriyañceva sukhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na sukhindriyaṃ.

The pleasure-faculty is both a faculty and the pleasure-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the pleasure-faculty.

(Ka) dukkhaṃ [V 3.0149] indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is pain a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā dukkhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the pain-faculty?

Dukkhindriyaṃ indriyañceva dukkhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na dukkhindriyaṃ.

The pain-faculty is both a faculty and the pain-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the pain-faculty.

(Ka) somanassaṃ [M 3.0100] indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is joy a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā somanassindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the joy-faculty?

Somanassindriyaṃ indriyañceva somanassindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na somanassindriyaṃ.

The joy-faculty is both a faculty and the joy-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the joy-faculty.

(Ka) domanassaṃ indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is displeasure a faculty? (b) Yes.

(Ka) indriyā domanassindriyanti?

(a) Are faculties the displeasure-faculty?

Domanassindriyaṃ indriyañceva domanassindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā [T 2.0165] na domanassindriyaṃ.

The displeasure-faculty is both a faculty and the displeasure-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the displeasure-faculty.

(Ka) upekkhā indriyanti?

(a) Is equanimity a faculty?

Yā upekkhā indriyaṃ sā upekkhā ceva indriyañca. Avasesā upekkhā na indriyaṃ.

That equanimity which is a faculty is both equanimity and a faculty. The remaining equanimity is not a faculty.

(Kha) indriyā upekkhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the equanimity-faculty?

Upekkhindriyaṃ indriyañceva upekkhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na upekkhindriyaṃ.

The equanimity-faculty is both a faculty and the equanimity-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the equanimity-faculty.

(Ka) saddhā indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is faith a faculty? (b) Yes.

(Kha) indriyā saddhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the faith-faculty?

Saddhindriyaṃ indriyañceva saddhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na saddhindriyaṃ.

The faith-faculty is both a faculty and the faith-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the faith-faculty.

(Ka) vīriyaṃ indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is energy a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā vīriyindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the energy-faculty?

Vīriyindriyaṃ indriyañceva vīriyindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na vīriyindriyaṃ.

The energy-faculty is both a faculty and the energy-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the energy-faculty.

(Ka) sati [V 3.0150] indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is mindfulness a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā satindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the mindfulness-faculty?

Satindriyaṃ indriyañceva satindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na satindriyaṃ.

The mindfulness-faculty is both a faculty and the mindfulness-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the mindfulness-faculty.

(Ka) samādhi indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is concentration a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā samādhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the concentration-faculty?

Samādhindriyaṃ indriyañceva samādhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na samādhindriyaṃ.

The concentration-faculty is both a faculty and the concentration-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the concentration-faculty.

(Ka) paññā indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is wisdom a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā paññindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the wisdom-faculty?

Paññindriyaṃ indriyañceva paññindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na paññindriyaṃ.

The wisdom-faculty is both a faculty and the wisdom-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the wisdom-faculty.

(Ka) anaññātaññassāmīti indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is 'I shall know the unknown' a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā anaññātaññassāmītindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown'?

Anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ indriyañceva anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ.

The faculty of 'I shall know the unknown' is both a faculty and the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown.' The remaining faculties are not the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown.'

(Ka) aññaṃ indriyanti[T 2.0166]? Āmantā.

(a) Is final knowledge a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā aññindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the final-knowledge-faculty?

Aññindriyaṃ indriyañceva aññindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na aññindriyaṃ.

The final-knowledge-faculty is both a faculty and the final-knowledge-faculty. The remaining faculties are not the final-knowledge-faculty.

(Ka) aññātāvī indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is 'one who has known' a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā aññātāvindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the faculty of one who has known?

Aññātāvindriyaṃ indriyañceva aññātāvindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na aññātāvindriyaṃ.

The faculty of one who has known is both a faculty and the faculty of one who has known. The remaining faculties are not the faculty of one who has known.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(b) Negative

141. (Ka) na [V 3.0151][M 3.0101] cakkhu na indriyanti?

141. (a) Is it neither the eye nor a faculty?

Cakkhuṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na cakkhu, indriyā. Cakkhuñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cakkhu na ca indriyā.

Except for the eye, the remaining faculties are not the eye, but they are faculties. And except for the eye and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the eye nor a faculty.

(Kha) na indriyā na cakkhundriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is what is not a faculty not the eye-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na sotaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither the ear nor a faculty?

Sotaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na sotaṃ, indriyā. Sotañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva sotaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for the ear, the remaining faculties are not the ear, but they are faculties. And except for the ear and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the ear nor a faculty.

(Kha) na indriyā na sotindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Is that which is not a faculty not the ear-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na ghānaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither the nose nor a faculty?

Ghānaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na ghānaṃ, indriyā. Ghānañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva ghānaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for the nose-faculty, the remaining faculties are not the nose-faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the nose-faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the nose-faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na ghānindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the nose-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na jivhā na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not the tongue not a faculty?

Jivhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na jivhā, indriyā. Jivhañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva jivhā na ca indriyā.

Except for the tongue-faculty, the remaining faculties are not the tongue-faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the tongue-faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the tongue-faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na jivhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the tongue-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na kāyo na indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is that which is not the body not a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) na indriyā na kāyindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the body-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na mano na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not the mind not a faculty?

Manaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na mano, indriyā. Manañca indriye [T 2.0167] ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva mano na ca indriyā.

Except for the mind-faculty, the remaining faculties are not the mind-faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the mind-faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the mind-faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na manindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the mind-faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na [V 3.0152] itthī na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not the female faculty not a faculty?

Itthiṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na itthī, indriyā. Itthiñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva itthī na ca indriyā.

Except for the female faculty, the remaining faculties are not the female faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the female faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the female faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na itthindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the female faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na puriso na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not the male faculty not a faculty?

Purisaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na puriso, indriyā. Purisañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva puriso na ca indriyā.

Except for the male faculty, the remaining faculties are not the male faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the male faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the male faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na purisindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the male faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na jīvitaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not the life faculty not a faculty?

Jīvitaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na jīvitaṃ, indriyā. Jīvitañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva jīvitaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for the life faculty, the remaining faculties are not the life faculty, but they are faculties. Except for the life faculty and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the life faculty nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the life faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na [M 3.0102] sukhaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not pleasure not a faculty?

Sukhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na sukhaṃ, indriyā. Sukhañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva sukhaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for pleasure, the remaining faculties are not pleasure, but they are faculties. Except for pleasure and the faculties, the remaining things are neither pleasure nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na sukhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of pleasure? Yes.

(Ka) na dukkhaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not pain not a faculty?

Dukkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na dukkhaṃ, indriyā. Dukkhañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva dukkhaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for pain, the remaining faculties are not pain, but they are faculties. Except for pain and the faculties, the remaining things are neither pain nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na dukkhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of pain? Yes.

(Ka) na somanassaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not joy not a faculty?

Somanassaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na somanassaṃ, indriyā. Somanassañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na [T 2.0168] ceva somanassaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for joy, the remaining faculties are not joy, but they are faculties. Except for joy and the faculties, the remaining things are neither joy nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na somanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of joy? Yes.

(Ka) na [V 3.0153] domanassaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not displeasure not a faculty?

Domanassaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na domanassaṃ, indriyā. Domanassañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva domanassaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for displeasure, the remaining faculties are not displeasure, but they are faculties. Except for displeasure and the faculties, the remaining things are neither displeasure nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na domanassindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of displeasure? Yes.

(Ka) na upekkhā na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not equanimity not a faculty?

Upekkhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na upekkhā, indriyā. Upekkhañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva upekkhā na ca indriyā.

Except for equanimity, the remaining faculties are not equanimity, but they are faculties. Except for equanimity and the faculties, the remaining things are neither equanimity nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na upekkhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of equanimity? Yes.

(Ka) na saddhā na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not faith not a faculty?

Saddhaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na saddhā, indriyā. Saddhañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva saddhā na ca indriyā.

Except for faith, the remaining faculties are not faith, but they are faculties. Except for faith and the faculties, the remaining things are neither faith nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na saddhindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of faith? Yes.

(Ka) na vīriyaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is that which is not energy not a faculty?

Vīriyaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na vīriyaṃ, indriyā. Vīriyañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vīriyaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for energy, the remaining faculties are not energy, but they are faculties. Except for energy and the faculties, the remaining things are neither energy nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na vīriyindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of energy? Yes.

(Ka) na sati na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither mindfulness nor a faculty?

Satiṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na sati, indriyā. Satiñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva sati na ca indriyā.

Except for mindfulness, the remaining faculties are not mindfulness, but they are faculties. And except for mindfulness and the faculties, the remaining things are neither mindfulness nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na satindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of mindfulness? Yes.

(Ka) na samādhi na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither concentration nor a faculty?

Samādhiṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na samādhi, indriyā. Samādhiñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva samādhi na ca indriyā.

Except for concentration, the remaining faculties are not concentration, but they are faculties. And except for concentration and the faculties, the remaining things are neither concentration nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na samādhindriyanti[T 2.0169]? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the concentration faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na [V 3.0154][M 3.0103] paññā na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither wisdom nor a faculty?

Paññaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na paññā, indriyā. Paññañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva paññā na ca indriyā.

Except for wisdom, the remaining faculties are not wisdom, but they are faculties. And except for wisdom and the faculties, the remaining things are neither wisdom nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na paññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the wisdom faculty? Yes.

(Ka) na anaññātaññassāmīti na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown' nor a faculty?

Anaññātaññassāmītiṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na anaññātaññassāmīti, indriyā. Anaññātaññassāmītiñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva anaññātaññassāmīti na ca indriyā.

Except for the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown,' the remaining faculties are not the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown,' but they are faculties. And except for the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown' and the faculties, the remaining things are neither the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown' nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na anaññātaññassāmītindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of 'I shall come to know the unknown'? Yes.

(Ka) na aññaṃ na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither final knowledge nor a faculty?

Aññaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na aññaṃ, indriyā. Aññañca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva aññaṃ na ca indriyā.

Except for final knowledge, the remaining faculties are not final knowledge, but they are faculties. And except for final knowledge and the faculties, the remaining things are neither final knowledge nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na aññindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of final knowledge? Yes.

(Ka) na aññātāvī na indriyanti?

(a) Is it neither one who has final knowledge nor a faculty?

Aññātāviṃ ṭhapetvā avasesā indriyā na aññātāvī, indriyā. Aññātāviñca indriye ca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva aññātāvī na ca indriyā.

Except for one who has final knowledge, the remaining faculties are not one who has final knowledge, but they are faculties. And except for one who has final knowledge and the faculties, the remaining things are neither one who has final knowledge nor faculties.

(Kha) na indriyā na aññātāvindriyanti? Āmantā.

(b) Are things that are not faculties not the faculty of one who has final knowledge? Yes.

(Ka) cakkhu indriyanti? Āmantā.

Manindriyaṃ indriyañceva manindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na manindriyaṃ.

(Ka) cakkhu indriyanti? Āmantā.

Itthindriyaṃ indriyañceva itthindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na itthindriyaṃ.

(Ka) cakkhu [M 3.0104] indriyanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) indriyā purisindriyanti?

Purisindriyaṃ indriyañceva purisindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na purisindriyaṃ.

(Ka) cakkhu [V 3.0156] indriyanti? Āmantā.

Jīvitindriyaṃ indriyañceva jīvitindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na jīvitindriyaṃ.

The life faculty is a faculty and it is the life faculty. The remaining faculties are not the life faculty.

(Ka) cakkhu indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the eye a faculty? Yes.

(Kha) indriyā sukhindriyanti?

(b) Are faculties the pleasure faculty?

Sukhindriyaṃ indriyañceva sukhindriyañca. Avasesā indriyā na sukhindriyaṃ.

The pleasure faculty is a faculty and it is the pleasure faculty. The remaining faculties are not the pleasure faculty.

(Ka) cakkhu indriyanti? Āmantā.

(a) Is the eye a faculty? Yes.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Present Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Direct Interrogation

186. (Ka) yassa [T 2.0184][V 3.0170][M 3.0113] cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa sotindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

186. (a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the ear-faculty arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati sotindriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the eye-faculty but not the ear-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-faculty is arising, but the ear-faculty is not arising for them. For those fit to have both the eye-faculty and the ear-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the eye-faculty is arising and the ear-faculty is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana sotindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the ear-faculty is arising, for that one is the eye-faculty arising?

Sasotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Sasotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the ear-faculty but not the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the ear-faculty is arising, but the eye-faculty is not arising for them. For those fit to have both the ear-faculty and the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the ear-faculty is arising and the eye-faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the nose-faculty arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the eye-faculty but not the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them the eye-faculty is arising, but the nose-faculty is not arising for them. For those fit to have both the eye-faculty and the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the eye-faculty is arising and the nose-faculty is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the nose-faculty is arising, for that one is the eye-faculty arising?

Saghānakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the nose-faculty but not the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the nose-faculty is arising, but the eye-faculty is not arising for them. For those fit to have both the nose-faculty and the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the nose-faculty is arising and the eye-faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 3.0171] cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti[T 2.0185]?

(a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the female faculty arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the eye-faculty who are not females and are being reborn, for them the eye-faculty is arising, but the female faculty is not arising for them. For females fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the eye-faculty is arising and the female faculty is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the female faculty is arising, for that one is the eye-faculty arising?

Itthīnaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tāsaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For females not fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the female faculty is arising, but the eye-faculty is not arising for them. For females fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the female faculty is arising and the eye-faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the male faculty arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those fit to have the eye-faculty who are not males and are being reborn, for them the eye-faculty is arising, but the male faculty is not arising for them. For males fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the eye-faculty is arising and the male faculty is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti[M 3.0114]?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the male faculty is arising, for that one is the eye-faculty arising?

Purisānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For males not fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the male faculty is arising, but the eye-faculty is not arising for them. For males fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the male faculty is arising and the eye-faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the life faculty arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the life faculty is arising, for that one is the eye-faculty arising?

Acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 2.0186] tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those not fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them the life faculty is arising, but the eye-faculty is not arising for them. For those fit to have the eye-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the life faculty is arising and the eye-faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye-faculty is arising, for that one is the faculty of joy arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ somanassena [V 3.0172] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the eye who are being reborn without joy, for them the eye faculty is arising, but the faculty of joy is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn with joy, for them both the eye faculty and the faculty of joy are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of joy is arising, for them is the eye faculty arising? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of equanimity arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the eye who are being reborn without equanimity, for them the eye faculty is arising, but the faculty of equanimity is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the eye faculty and the faculty of equanimity are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of equanimity is arising, for them is the eye faculty arising?

Upekkhāya acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the eye who are being reborn with equanimity, for them the faculty of equanimity is arising, but the eye faculty is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the faculty of equanimity and the eye faculty are arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of faith arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati[T 2.0187].

For those with the eye who are being reborn without root-conditions, for them the eye faculty is arising, but the faculty of faith is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn with root-conditions, for them both the eye faculty and the faculty of faith are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of faith is arising, for them is the eye faculty arising?

Sahetukānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those with root-conditions and without the eye who are being reborn, for them the faculty of faith is arising, but the eye faculty is not arising for them. For those with root-conditions and with the eye who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of faith and the eye faculty are arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the eye faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of wisdom arising?

Sacakkhukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ [V 3.0173] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhundriyañca [M 3.0115] uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the eye who are being reborn dissociated from knowledge, for them the eye faculty is arising, but the faculty of wisdom is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them both the eye faculty and the faculty of wisdom are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of wisdom is arising, for them is the eye faculty arising?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the eye who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them the faculty of wisdom is arising, but the eye faculty is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them both the faculty of wisdom and the eye faculty are arising.

(Ka) yassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For one for whom the eye faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of mind arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of mind is arising, for them is the eye faculty arising?

Sacittakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacakkhukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati. (Cakkhundriyamūlakaṃ)

For those with mind and without the eye who are being reborn, for them the faculty of mind is arising, but the eye faculty is not arising for them. For those with the eye who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of mind and the eye faculty are arising. (The Eye-Faculty Root)

187. (Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti[T 2.0188]?

187. (a) For one for whom the faculty of smell is arising, for them is the faculty of femininity arising?

Saghānakānaṃ na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the faculty of smell who are not female and are being reborn, for them the faculty of smell is arising, but the faculty of femininity is not arising for them. For those females with the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of smell and the faculty of femininity are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of femininity is arising, for them is the faculty of smell arising?

Itthīnaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tāsaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For females without the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them the faculty of femininity is arising, but the faculty of smell is not arising for them. For females with the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of femininity and the faculty of smell are arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the faculty of smell is arising, for them is the faculty of masculinity arising?

Saghānakānaṃ na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the faculty of smell who are not male and are being reborn, for them the faculty of smell is arising, but the faculty of masculinity is not arising for them. For males with the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of smell and the faculty of masculinity are arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of masculinity is arising, for them is the faculty of smell arising?

Purisānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no [V 3.0174] ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For males without the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them the faculty of masculinity is arising, but the faculty of smell is not arising for them. For males with the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of masculinity and the faculty of smell are arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For one for whom the faculty of smell is arising, for them is the faculty of life arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the faculty of life is arising, for them is the faculty of smell arising?

Aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no [T 2.0189] ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them the faculty of life is arising, but the faculty of smell is not arising for them. For those with the faculty of smell who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of life and the faculty of smell are arising.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(a) For one for whom the faculty of smell is arising, for them is the faculty of joy arising?

Saghānakānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ [M 3.0116] somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ somanassena upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn without joy, for them the nose-faculty arises, but the faculty of joy does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn with joy, for them both the nose-faculty and the faculty of joy arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of joy arises, for them does the nose-faculty arise?

Somanassena aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ somanassindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn with joy, for them the faculty of joy arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn with joy, for them both the faculty of joy and the nose-faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whom the nose-faculty arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Saghānakānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn without equanimity, for them the nose-faculty arises, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the nose-faculty and the faculty of equanimity arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the nose-faculty arise?

Upekkhāya aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati[V 3.0175], no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn with equanimity, for them the faculty of equanimity arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the faculty of equanimity and the nose-faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0190] ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whom the nose-faculty arises, for them does the faculty of faith arise?

Saghānakānaṃ ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the nose-faculty who are rootless and are being reborn, for them the nose-faculty arises, but the faculty of faith does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are accompanied by roots and are being reborn, for them both the nose-faculty and the faculty of faith arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of faith arises, for them does the nose-faculty arise?

Sahetukānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are accompanied by roots but without the nose-faculty and are being reborn, for them the faculty of faith arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise. For those who are accompanied by roots and with the nose-faculty and are being reborn, for them both the faculty of faith and the nose-faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whom the nose-faculty arises, for them does the faculty of wisdom arise?

Saghānakānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ ghānindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn dissociated from knowledge, for them the nose-faculty arises, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them both the nose-faculty and the faculty of wisdom arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of wisdom arises, for them does the nose-faculty arise?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ aghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

For those without the nose-faculty who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them the faculty of wisdom arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn associated with knowledge, for them both the faculty of wisdom and the nose-faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the nose-faculty arises, for them does the mind-faculty arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti[T 2.0191]?

Or, for whomever the mind-faculty arises, for them does the nose-faculty arise?

Sacittakānaṃ aghānakānaṃ [M 3.0117] upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Saghānakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati. (Ghānindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those with mind but without the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them the mind-faculty arises, but the nose-faculty does not arise. For those with the nose-faculty who are being reborn, for them both the mind-faculty and the nose-faculty arise. (Rooted in the nose-faculty)

188. (Ka) yassa [V 3.0176] itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

188. For whomever the female faculty arises, for them does the male faculty arise? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

Or, for whomever the male faculty arises, for them does the female faculty arise? No.

(Ka) yassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the female faculty arises, for them does the life-faculty arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the life-faculty arises, for them does the female faculty arise?

Na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For non-females who are being reborn, for them the life-faculty arises, but the female faculty does not arise. For females who are being reborn, for them both the life-faculty and the female faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the female faculty arises, for them does the faculty of joy arise?

Itthīnaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tāsaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ somanassena upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For females being reborn without joy, for them the female faculty arises, but the faculty of joy does not arise. For females being reborn with joy, for them both the female faculty and the faculty of joy arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of joy arises, for them does the female faculty arise?

Somanassena na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ somanassindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For non-females being reborn with joy, for them the faculty of joy arises, but the female faculty does not arise. For females being reborn with joy, for them both the faculty of joy and the female faculty arise.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0192] itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the female faculty arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Itthīnaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tāsaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For females being reborn without equanimity, for them the female faculty arises, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For females being reborn with equanimity, for them both the female faculty and the faculty of equanimity arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the female faculty arise?

Upekkhāya na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are not female and are being reborn with equanimity, the faculty of equanimity is arising, but the female faculty is not arising. For females who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the faculty of equanimity is arising and the female faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the female faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of faith arising?

Itthīnaṃ ahetukānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no [V 3.0177] ca tāsaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ sahetukānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati.

For rootless females who are being reborn, the female faculty is arising, but the faculty of faith is not arising. For females with roots who are being reborn, for them both the female faculty is arising and the faculty of faith is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of faith is arising, for them is the female faculty arising?

Sahetukānaṃ na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no [M 3.0118] ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with roots who are not female and are being reborn, the faculty of faith is arising, but the female faculty is not arising. For females with roots who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of faith is arising and the female faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the female faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of wisdom arising?

Itthīnaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tāsaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ [T 2.0193] upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ itthindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For females dissociated from knowledge who are being reborn, the female faculty is arising, but the faculty of wisdom is not arising. For females associated with knowledge who are being reborn, for them both the female faculty is arising and the faculty of wisdom is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of wisdom is arising, for them is the female faculty arising?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati.

For those associated with knowledge who are not female and are being reborn, the faculty of wisdom is arising, but the female faculty is not arising. For females associated with knowledge who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of wisdom is arising and the female faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the female faculty is arising, for them is the faculty of mind arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa itthindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of mind is arising, for them is the female faculty arising?

Sacittakānaṃ na itthīnaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ itthindriyaṃ uppajjati. Itthīnaṃ upapajjantīnaṃ tāsaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati itthindriyañca uppajjati. (Itthindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those with mind who are not female and are being reborn, the faculty of mind is arising, but the female faculty is not arising. For females who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of mind is arising and the female faculty is arising. (The Section on the Female Faculty)

189. (Ka) yassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

189. For whomever the male faculty is arising, for them is the life faculty arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the life faculty is arising, for them is the male faculty arising?

Na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are not male and are being reborn, the life faculty is arising, but the male faculty is not arising. For males who are being reborn, for them both the life faculty is arising and the male faculty is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 3.0178] purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the faculty of masculinity is arising, for them is the faculty of joy arising?

Purisānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ somanassena upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca [T 2.0194] uppajjati.

For males who are being reborn without joy, the faculty of masculinity is arising, but the faculty of joy is not arising. For males who are being reborn with joy, for them both the faculty of masculinity is arising and the faculty of joy is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of joy is arising, for them is the faculty of masculinity arising?

Somanassena na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ somanassindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are not male and are being reborn with joy, the faculty of joy is arising, but the faculty of masculinity is not arising. For males who are being reborn with joy, for them both the faculty of joy is arising and the faculty of masculinity is arising.

(Ka) yassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the faculty of masculinity is arising, for them is the faculty of equanimity arising?

Purisānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati [M 3.0119] upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For males who are being reborn without equanimity, the faculty of masculinity is arising, but the faculty of equanimity is not arising. For males who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the faculty of masculinity is arising and the faculty of equanimity is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of equanimity is arising, for them is the faculty of masculinity arising?

Upekkhāya na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are not male and are being reborn with equanimity, the faculty of equanimity is arising, but the faculty of masculinity is not arising. For males who are being reborn with equanimity, for them both the faculty of equanimity is arising and the faculty of masculinity is arising.

(Ka) yassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the faculty of masculinity is arising, for them is the faculty of faith arising?

Purisānaṃ ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati.

For rootless males who are being reborn, the faculty of masculinity is arising, but the faculty of faith is not arising. For males with roots who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of masculinity is arising and the faculty of faith is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of faith is arising, for them is the faculty of masculinity arising?

Sahetukānaṃ na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati[T 2.0195], no [V 3.0179] ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with roots who are not male and are being reborn, the faculty of faith is arising, but the faculty of masculinity is not arising. For males with roots who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of faith is arising and the faculty of masculinity is arising.

(Ka) yassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the faculty of masculinity is arising, for them is the faculty of wisdom arising?

Purisānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ purisindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For males dissociated from knowledge who are being reborn, the faculty of masculinity is arising, but the faculty of wisdom is not arising. For males associated with knowledge who are being reborn, for them both the faculty of masculinity is arising and the faculty of wisdom is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever the faculty of wisdom is arising, for them is the faculty of masculinity arising?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

For non-males associated with knowledge who are being reborn, for them the wisdom faculty arises, but for them the masculinity faculty does not arise. For males associated with knowledge who are being reborn, for them both the wisdom faculty arises and the masculinity faculty arises.

(Ka) yassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomsoever the masculinity faculty arises, for them does the mind faculty arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whomsoever the mind faculty arises, for them does the masculinity faculty arise?

Sacittakānaṃ na purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Purisānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati. (Purisindriyamūlakaṃ)

For non-males with consciousness who are being reborn, for them the mind faculty arises, but for them the masculinity faculty does not arise. For males who are being reborn, for them both the mind faculty arises and the masculinity faculty arises. (The Masculinity Faculty Section)

190. (Ka) yassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

190. For whomsoever the life faculty arises, for them does the joy faculty arise?

Vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ [T 2.0196] somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn without joy, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from joy during the course of existence, for them the life faculty arises, but for them the joy faculty does not arise. For those who are being reborn with joy, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with joy during the course of existence, for them both the life faculty arises and the joy faculty arises.

(Kha) yassa [M 3.0120] vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the joy faculty arises, for them does the life faculty arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [V 3.0180] jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the life faculty arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn without equanimity, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from equanimity during the course of existence, for them the life faculty arises, but for them the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For those who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with equanimity during the course of existence, for them both the life faculty arises and the faculty of equanimity arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the life faculty arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the life faculty arises, for them does the faculty of faith arise?

Ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those being reborn without root-conditions, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from faith during the course of existence, for them the life faculty arises, but for them the faculty of faith does not arise. For those being reborn with root-conditions, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with faith during the course of existence, for them both the life faculty arises and the faculty of faith arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the faculty of faith arises, for them does the life faculty arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the life faculty arises, for them does the faculty of wisdom arise?

Ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇavippayuttacittassa [T 2.0197] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those being reborn dissociated from knowledge, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness dissociated from knowledge during the course of existence, for them the life faculty arises, but for them the faculty of wisdom does not arise. For those being reborn associated with knowledge, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with knowledge during the course of existence, for them both the life faculty arises and the faculty of wisdom arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the faculty of wisdom arises, for them does the life faculty arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the life faculty arises, for them does the mind faculty arise?

Acittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ tesaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sacittakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ jīvitindriyañca uppajjati manindriyañca uppajjati.

For those being reborn without consciousness, for them the life faculty arises, but the mind faculty does not arise. For those being reborn with consciousness, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness during the course of existence, for them both the life faculty arises and the mind faculty arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā. (Jīvitindriyamūlakaṃ)

Or for whomsoever the mind faculty arises, for them does the life faculty arise? Yes. (The Life Faculty Section)

191. (Ka) yassa [V 3.0181] somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

191. For whomsoever the joy faculty arises, for them does the equanimity faculty arise? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

Or for whomsoever the equanimity faculty arises, for them does the joy faculty arise? No.

(Ka) yassa [M 3.0121] somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the joy faculty arises, for them does the faith faculty arise?

Pavatte somanassasampayuttasaddhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassasampayuttasaddhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ somanassindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati[T 2.0198].

For those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with joy but dissociated from faith during the course of existence, for them the joy faculty arises, but the faith faculty does not arise. For those being reborn with joy, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with joy and with faith during the course of existence, for them both the joy faculty arises and the faith faculty arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or for whomsoever the faith faculty arises, for them does the joy faculty arise?

Sahetukānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttasomanassavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttasomanassasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with root-conditions who are being reborn without joy, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from joy during the course of existence, for them the faith faculty arises, but the joy faculty does not arise. For those being reborn with joy, and for those at the arising-moment of consciousness associated with faith and with joy during the course of existence, for them both the faith faculty arises and the joy faculty arises.

(Ka) yassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomsoever the joy faculty arises, for them does the wisdom faculty arise?

Somanassena ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassasampayuttañāṇavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassasampayuttañāṇasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ somanassindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are being reborn with gladness and are dissociated from knowledge, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with gladness and dissociated from knowledge, for them the faculty of gladness arises, but for them the faculty of wisdom does not arise. For those who are being reborn with gladness and are associated with knowledge, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with gladness and with knowledge, for them both the faculty of gladness arises and the faculty of wisdom arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of wisdom arises, for them does the faculty of gladness arise?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇasampayuttasomanassavippayuttacittassa [V 3.0182] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇasampayuttasomanassasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati.

For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn without gladness, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge and dissociated from gladness, for them the faculty of wisdom arises, but for them the faculty of gladness does not arise. For those who are associated with knowledge and are being reborn with gladness, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge and with gladness, for them both the faculty of wisdom arises and the faculty of gladness arises.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0199] somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the faculty of gladness arises, for them does the faculty of mind arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of mind arises, for them does the faculty of gladness arise?

Sacittakānaṃ vinā somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati. Somanassena upapajjantānaṃ pavatte somanassasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati somanassindriyañca uppajjati. (Somanassindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those with consciousness who are being reborn without gladness, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness dissociated from gladness, for them the faculty of mind arises, but for them the faculty of gladness does not arise. For those who are being reborn with gladness, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with gladness, for them both the faculty of mind arises and the faculty of gladness arises. (The section rooted in the faculty of gladness)

192. (Ka) yassa [M 3.0122] upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

192. For whomever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the faculty of faith arise?

Upekkhāya ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttasaddhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttasaddhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those rootless ones who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity but dissociated from faith, for them the faculty of equanimity arises, but the faculty of faith does not arise. For those with roots who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity and with faith, for them both the faculty of equanimity arises and the faculty of faith arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of faith arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Sahetukānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttaupekkhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttaupekkhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with roots who are being reborn without equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from equanimity, for them the faculty of faith arises, but the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For those with roots who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith and with equanimity, for them both the faculty of faith arises and the faculty of equanimity arises.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0200][V 3.0183] upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

For whomever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the faculty of wisdom arise?

Upekkhāya ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttañāṇavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttañāṇasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ upekkhindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those dissociated from knowledge who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity but dissociated from knowledge, for them the faculty of equanimity arises, but the faculty of wisdom does not arise. For those associated with knowledge who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity and with knowledge, for them both the faculty of equanimity arises and the faculty of wisdom arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of wisdom arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇasampayuttaupekkhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇasampayuttaupekkhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ paññindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati.

For those associated with knowledge who are being reborn without equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge but dissociated from equanimity, for them the faculty of wisdom arises, but for them the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For those associated with knowledge who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge and with equanimity, for them both the faculty of wisdom arises and the faculty of equanimity arises.

(Ka) yassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the faculty of equanimity arises, for them does the faculty of mind arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of mind arises, for them does the faculty of equanimity arise?

Sacittakānaṃ vinā upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Upekkhāya upapajjantānaṃ pavatte upekkhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati upekkhindriyañca uppajjati. (Upekkhindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those with attainable consciousness who are being reborn without equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness dissociated from equanimity, for them the faculty of mind arises, but for them the faculty of equanimity does not arise. For those who are being reborn with equanimity, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with equanimity, for them both the faculty of mind arises and the faculty of equanimity arises. (The section rooted in the faculty of equanimity)

193. (Ka) yassa [T 2.0201] saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

193. For whomever the faculty of faith arises, for them does the faculty of wisdom arise?

Sahetukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttañāṇavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe [M 3.0123] tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte [V 3.0184] saddhāsampayuttañāṇasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ saddhindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati.

For those with roots who are being reborn dissociated from knowledge, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith but dissociated from knowledge, for them the faculty of faith arises, but for them the faculty of wisdom does not arise. For those with roots who are being reborn associated with knowledge, and for those who, in the course of existence, are at the arising moment of a consciousness associated with faith and with knowledge, for them both the faculty of faith arises and the faculty of wisdom arises.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or, for whomever the faculty of wisdom arises, for them does the faculty of faith arise? Yes.

(Ka) yassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For whomever the faculty of faith arises, for them does the faculty of mind arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa saddhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, for whomever the faculty of mind arises, for them does the faculty of faith arise?

Sacittakānaṃ ahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāvippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ saddhindriyaṃ uppajjati. Sahetukānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte saddhāsampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati saddhindriyañca uppajjati. (Saddhindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those rootless beings with consciousness who are being reborn, and for those during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a consciousness dissociated from faith, for them the mind-faculty arises, but the faith-faculty does not arise. For those with roots who are being reborn, and for those during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a consciousness associated with faith, for them both the mind-faculty and the faith-faculty arise. (The Faith-Faculty Section)

194. (Ka) yassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa manindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

194. (A) For whomever the wisdom-faculty arises, for them does the mind-faculty arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana manindriyaṃ uppajjati tassa paññindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or, for whomever the mind-faculty arises, for them does the wisdom-faculty arise?

Sacittakānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ pavatte ñāṇavippayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ paññindriyaṃ uppajjati. Ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ [T 2.0202] pavatte ñāṇasampayuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ manindriyañca uppajjati paññindriyañca uppajjati. (Paññindriyamūlakaṃ)

For those beings with consciousness dissociated from knowledge who are being reborn, and for those during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a consciousness dissociated from knowledge, for them the mind-faculty arises, but the wisdom-faculty does not arise. For those associated with knowledge who are being reborn, and for those during the course of existence at the arising-moment of a consciousness associated with knowledge, for them both the mind-faculty and the wisdom-faculty arise. (The Wisdom-Faculty Section)

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(B) The Occasion of Conformity

195. (Ka) yattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha sotindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

195. (A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the ear-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana sotindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or, where the ear-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha ghānindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the nose-faculty arise there?

Rūpāvacare tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati. Kāmāvacare tattha cakkhundriyañca uppajjati ghānindriyañca uppajjati.

In the form-sphere, the eye-faculty arises there, but the nose-faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the eye-faculty and the nose-faculty arise there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana ghānindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or, where the nose-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha [V 3.0185] cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha itthindriyaṃ…pe… purisindriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the female-faculty… the male-faculty arise there?

Rūpāvacare tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha purisindriyaṃ uppajjati. Kāmāvacare tattha cakkhundriyañca uppajjati purisindriyañca uppajjati.

In the form-sphere, the eye-faculty arises there, but the male-faculty does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the eye-faculty and the male-faculty arise there.

(Kha) yattha vā pana purisindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or, where the male-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha [M 3.0124] cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the life-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or, where the life-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there?

Asaññasatte arūpe tattha jīvitindriyaṃ uppajjati, no ca tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati. Pañcavokāre tattha jīvitindriyañca uppajjati cakkhundriyañca uppajjati.

In the plane of non-percipient beings and in the formless planes, the life-faculty arises there, but the eye-faculty does not arise there. In the five-constituent plane, both the life-faculty and the eye-faculty arise there.

(Ka) yattha [T 2.0203] cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha somanassindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the joy-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana somanassindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(B) Or, where the joy-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjati tattha upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(A) Where the eye-faculty arises, does the equanimity-faculty arise there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana upekkhindriyaṃ uppajjati tattha cakkhundriyaṃ uppajjatīti?

(B) Or, where the equanimity-faculty arises, does the eye-faculty arise there?
